message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV and NumPy files and parses YAML config without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, label value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tools are present anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code reads CSV and NumPy files directly without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models; it trains models from scratch, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is implemented or needed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splits exist via fold indices, there is no signing, hashing, or isolation enforcement of evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: Inputs are loaded directly from files (CSV, NumPy arrays) and passed to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (predictions, scores) are returned from test() and used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph neural network (GCN/GAE) pipeline for gene regulatory network inference, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
